CALS 3.0 overall minimum; Biological Sciences 3.5
ILR most admits at least 3.4 (typical)
Human Ecology 3.5 or higher, mostly As and Bs
Hotel no minimum; admits generally 3.3+

A&S internal: 3.0 cumulative and 3.0 in 12 credits; Hotel internal 3.0 Cornell GPA, transferees excluded
Human Ecology 23 sophomore credits, 8 lab science, 6 writing
ILR junior prerequisites: two composition, micro and macro
CALS bars more than four semesters at a four-year school; CALS and Human Ecology want letter grades; associate's fixes junior standing in CALS
